name: Citation fidelity regression: render is by-construction faithful; post-render hand edits must be caught
purpose: Regression test for the originally reported failure mode (hand-assembled citations desyncing from the evidence: wrong titles, orphaned numbers, post-render polish drift). Since deep-research 1.5.0 the References section is GENERATED by evidence-ledger.py render, so fidelity is by construction; this case verifies the construction actually ran (render + vet structural audit) and that nothing edited the rendered output afterwards (re-render diff = 0), plus that quantitative claims still carry in-text citations.
prompt:
no-interview light-research: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, survey the recent article landscape on tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte therapy in solid tumors. Cite sources with PMIDs. Keep the survey contained: at most 2 research aspects and at most 8 cited sources per aspect (pass strict per-query source limits to every worker).

After final_report.md is rendered (Step 5b) and vetted (Step 5c included), verify citation fidelity:
1. Re-render the draft to a throwaway copy: python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py render reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl reports/<TOPIC>/final_report.draft.md -o reports/<TOPIC>/.fidelity-recheck.md   (must exit 0)
2. Diff the References section of reports/<TOPIC>/.fidelity-recheck.md against reports/<TOPIC>/final_report.md entry by entry (titles verbatim, locators, DOIs, PMIDs, ordering, and the in-text numbering around them).
3. Spot-check three quantitative claims (any number: percentages, counts, effect sizes) in final_report.md and confirm each carries an in-text citation marker [N] in the same sentence or table row.
4. In your FINAL message, end with the exact line 'MISMATCH COUNT: <n>' where <n> is the number of References entries that differ between the re-render and final_report.md (0 means nothing edited the rendered output). Above that line, state the quantitative-claims spot-check result. The graded expectation is 0 with all three sampled claims cited.

checks.desc: tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys (add echo / check stdout) contain line-start pmid: entries (observed live: a correct 2-worker dispatch run had zero article_search events in the parent log - only the orchestrator's gene_search pre-check appeared)
render verb banner: the numbering authority generated the citations + References (fidelity is by construction only if render ran)
the Step 5c offline structural audit passed: contiguous [1]..[N], N == bibliography count, zero placeholders
re-render of the draft equals the shipped References section entry-for-entry - no post-render hand edits (any non-zero count FAILS this case by design - no escape arm)
